title: The Smartphone CPU Review You NEED to Watch!
summary: Geekerwan reviews smartphone CPUs by power efficiency rather than benchmark scores, with test methodology and chapters on Qualcomm, Apple, Samsung and Google chips. It explains why high benchmark scores can coexist with heat and poor battery life.
why: HN people cite it as detailed data on mobile SoC efficiency, sustained performance and ARM core efficiency curves.

quote.text: explores the power efficiency graphs and that's probably what most phone users really want
